bio.text: Chantel Jackson represents New York's 79th Assembly District in the Bronx, which includes Concourse Village, Melrose, Morrisania, Claremont, Belmont and East Tremont.
She was born in Harlem and holds a bachelor's degree in psychology from City College of New York and a Master of Social Work from Adelphi University.

Before the Assembly she spent nine years working with low-income, first-generation students on college access and financial aid, and then four years as a school social worker in New York City public high schools.
